edges: ENGIE remains a reference shareholder at 31 percent and is a leading industrial player in two projects of 496 MW each in partnership with Sumitomo Corporation.

multi_hop_neighbors.edge: Dieppe-Le Treport has acquired a 29.5% interest in two French offshore wind farms owned by a consortium including ENGIE.
Sumitomo Corporation is a leading industrial player in major European offshore wind projects with La Banque des Territoires.
Sumitomo Corporation is heavily involved in wind energy projects in partnership with EDPR.
